rapidResolution.name: Rapid Resolution
rapidResolution.oneLineDescription: Rapid Resolution starts immediately and, once complete disclosure arrives, analyzes and advances your eligible Alberta ticket within 48 hours, pursuing a withdrawal or a reduced charge that may lower the fine and/or demerits.
rapidResolution.actionCommitment: Complete, readable disclosure is reviewed and the next authorized prosecutor step is prepared or submitted within 48 hours after it is received and matched to your file.
included: Technology-assisted disclosure analysis with qualified review
Immediate client notifications when the file changes
Plain-language comparison of the original ticket and any Crown response
Client-directed acceptance of an available pre-trial resolution
excluded: Immediate Roadside Sanctions and Notices of Administrative Penalty
Government fines, court charges and third-party fees
Matters outside Fabsy's permitted or accepted agent scope
rapidResolution.speedDisclaimer: The 48-hour clock begins only after complete, readable disclosure is received and matched to the file. It covers Fabsy's review and next authorized action, not Crown response time or the date of a final outcome.
rapidResolution.outcomeDisclaimer: Outcomes depend on the charge, evidence, procedure and prosecutor. A withdrawal, reduction, lower fine, fewer demerits or insurance result is not promised.

insuranceReport.name: Insurance Impact & Renewal Planning Report
insuranceReport.description: A personalized, source-backed planning report covering potential conviction impact, renewal timing, conviction-aging dates, public insurance research sources and questions to ask a licensed broker.
insuranceReport.disclaimer: This report provides consumer research and planning information, not an insurer quote, licensed broker recommendation or promise of eligibility, premium savings or a particular insurance outcome. Fabsy is not an insurance agent or broker and does not sell, quote or place insurance.

bundle.name: Rapid Resolution + Insurance Planning
bundle.description: Rapid Resolution for an eligible Alberta ticket plus the Insurance Impact & Renewal Planning Report for one transparent bundle price.

canonicalPricingCopy: Rapid Resolution costs $198 CAD plus applicable GST for eligible Alberta pre-trial matters. The Insurance Impact & Renewal Planning Report costs $49 CAD plus applicable GST, or both products cost $229 CAD plus applicable GST. Trial representation, government fines and out-of-scope matters are separate.
